name: What due diligence should I perform when buying a vacation home in a flood zone?

mainEntity.name: What due diligence should I perform when buying a vacation home in a flood zone?

acceptedAnswer.text: When buying a vacation home in a designated flood zone, thorough due diligence is essential. This includes obtaining a recent flood elevation certificate, understanding the property's flood risk, and researching flood insurance costs. Reviewing past flood claims on the property and understanding evacuation routes are also critical. While a flood zone might seem concerning, many properties are well-protected, and understanding the specifics will help you make an informed decision. Our team can assist in navigating these considerations in high-risk areas within our service counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: In a flood zone, conduct thorough due diligence: obtain an elevation certificate, understand flood risk and insurance costs, and review past claims. This helps in making an informed decision.
